Summary Description: RESEARCH ARTICLE Open Access Crystal structure and DNA binding activity of a PadR family transcription regulator from hypervirulent Clostridium difficile R20291 Catherine E. Richter-Addo2 and Elizabeth A. Karr1* Abstract Background: Clostridium difficile is a spore-forming obligate anaerobe that can remain viable for extended periods, even in the presence of antibiotics, which contributes to the persistence of this bacterium as a human pathogen during host-to-host transmission and in hospital environments.
